- Gold down = odd given oil spike, no clear safe-money bid showing up 🚩 relationship expected here but data doesn't match

- Fear meter (VIX) barely moved = calm despite Middle East oil chaos in headlines
- Oil up sharply (WTI +4%, Brent +2.6%) = Saudi Aramco pipeline shut, Yanbu loadings suspended, Libya force majeure - real supply-risk premium building
- Dollar up slightly = mild safe-haven bid, consistent with oil-shock playbook
